heading: Watch agent SSH sessions live
summary: Agent SSH sessions open a live tab you can watch and type in.
changes: See each command an agent runs and its output as it happens, and type in the same session yourself.
A denied agent request now says why, such as missing or outdated permission.
Double-click a bookmark to open an SSH tab.
notice: Close active sessions before updating. Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon.
